label: Hands
description: Hands dealt in.

label: bb/100
description: Big blinds won per 100 hands.

label: EV bb/100
description: All-in adjusted big blinds won per 100 hands.

label: Showdown bb/100
description: Big blinds won at showdown per 100 hands.

label: Non-showdown bb/100
description: Big blinds won without showdown per 100 hands.

label: C-bet flop
description: Bet the flop as the preflop aggressor when checked to or first to act.
notes: An opportunity is a flop decision facing nothing. v1 counted every flop the aggressor saw: flops where a donk bet came first, and flops the aggressor reached all-in preflop with no decision to make (17,102 of the pool's 20,121 heads-up 5-bet flops), which showed up as missed c-bets (4.8% there vs 78.9% here). -5.5% opportunities on the pool overall.

label: C-bet turn
description: Bet the turn after c-betting the flop (double barrel).
notes: The opportunity is the chance to bet (nothing in front) as the flop's last aggressor; v1 counted every turn seen after betting the flop, including turns where a lead came first and flops where the c-bet was raised and called (-11% opportunities, +5 points).

label: C-bet river
description: Bet the river after barrelling the turn (triple barrel).
notes: The opportunity is the chance to bet (nothing in front) as the turn's last aggressor; v1 counted every river seen after betting the turn (-12% opportunities, +7 points).

label: Delayed c-bet
description: Bet the turn as the aggressor after checking the flop.
notes: v1 required only "did not bet the flop", which included calling a flop donk bet.

label: Fold to c-bet flop
description: Folded facing the preflop aggressor's flop bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front; v1 still counted it as faced when another player had raised it before this seat acted (-0.5% opportunities).

label: Call c-bet flop
description: Called facing the preflop aggressor's flop bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front (see fold_to_cbet_flop).

label: Raise c-bet flop
description: Raised the preflop aggressor's flop bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front (see fold_to_cbet_flop).

label: Fold to c-bet turn
description: Folded facing the preflop aggressor's turn bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front (see fold_to_cbet_flop).

label: Fold to c-bet river
description: Folded facing the preflop aggressor's river bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front (see fold_to_cbet_flop).

label: Fold to delayed c-bet
description: Folded to the aggressor's turn bet after the flop checked through.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; v1 counted the opportunity from hand-level flags whenever the aggressor bet the turn (-0.4% opportunities).

label: Float flop
description: Bet the turn when checked to, after calling a flop bet in position.
notes: The opportunity needs the turn checked to this seat; v1 counted every turn reached after calling in position, turns where the opponent led included (about 40% of v1's opportunities, the rate roughly doubles).

label: Float, fold turn
description: Folded to a turn bet after calling a flop bet in position.
notes: v1's denominator was "called the flop c-bet and reached the turn" from any position, turns checked through included; this counts in-position turns where a bet was actually faced, the decision the name describes (about a third of v1's action count).

label: Donk bet flop
description: Led into the preflop aggressor on the flop, out of position.
notes: The opportunity is the chance to bet (nothing in front); v1 counted every out-of-position non-aggressor on the flop, those facing an earlier lead included (-3% opportunities).

label: Fold to donk bet
description: Folded as the preflop aggressor when led into on the flop.
notes: The lead must be the only bet in front; v1 also counted a lead that was raised before the aggressor acted (-1% opportunities).

label: Probe turn
description: Bet the turn out of position after the aggressor checked back the flop.
notes: v1 did not require out of position.

label: Fold to probe turn
description: Checked back the flop as the aggressor, then folded to a turn bet.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; v1 counted the opportunity from hand-level flags whenever a turn bet happened (-0.5% opportunities).

label: Probe river
description: Bet the river out of position after the turn checked through.
notes: v1 did not require out of position.

label: Fold to probe river
description: Folded as the aggressor to a river bet after the turn checked through.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; v1 counted the opportunity from hand-level flags whenever a river bet happened (-0.2% opportunities).

label: Check-raise flop
description: Raised the flop after checking and facing a bet.
notes: The bet must be the only one in front; v1 counted the chance when a raise had followed the bet before this seat acted (-0.9% opportunities).

label: Check-raise turn
description: Raised the turn after checking and facing a bet.
notes: The bet must be the only one in front (see check_raise_flop).

label: Check-raise river
description: Raised the river after checking and facing a bet.
notes: The bet must be the only one in front (see check_raise_flop).

label: Fold to flop raise
description: Bet the flop and folded when raised.
notes: Exactly one raise in front of the bet; v1 counted any second aggressive action on the street, a re-raise or the seat's own raise included (-0.3% opportunities).

label: Fold to turn raise
description: Bet the turn and folded when raised.
notes: Exactly one raise in front of the bet; v1 counted any second aggressive action on the street (-0.2% opportunities).

label: Fold to river raise
description: Bet the river and folded when raised.
notes: Exactly one raise in front of the bet; v1 counted any second aggressive action on the street (-0.2% opportunities).

label: Bet-call river
description: Bet the river and called a raise.
notes: Exactly one raise in front of the bet; v1 counted any second aggressive action on the street (-0.2% opportunities).

label: River raise
description: Raised when facing a river bet.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; v1 also counted facing a bet that had already been raised (-0.3% opportunities).

label: River check-fold
description: Checked the river, then folded to a bet.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; v1 also counted a bet that had been raised before this seat acted (-0.3% opportunities).

label: River check-call
description: Checked the river, then called a bet.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; v1 also counted a bet that had been raised before this seat acted (-0.3% opportunities).

label: Aggression factor (flop)
description: Bets and raises divided by calls on the flop.

label: Aggression factor (turn)
description: Bets and raises divided by calls on the turn.

label: Aggression factor (river)
description: Bets and raises divided by calls on the river.

label: Aggression factor
description: Postflop bets and raises divided by postflop calls.

label: Aggression frequency (flop)
description: Share of flop actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: Aggression frequency (turn)
description: Share of turn actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: Aggression frequency (river)
description: Share of river actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: Aggression frequency
description: Share of postflop actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: VPIP
description: Voluntarily put money in the pot preflop, per hand dealt in (blind posts excluded).

label: PFR
description: Raised preflop, per hand dealt in.

label: RFI (open %)
description: Raised when first in, from any position.

label: Steal %
description: Raised first in from the cutoff, button or small blind.

label: Limp %
description: Called the big blind when first in rather than raising.

label: Isolation raise %
description: Raised over one or more limpers with no raise in front.

label: Cold call %
description: Called a raise at the first decision of the hand, not already invested as a blind.

label: Call vs open
description: Called when facing exactly one raise, from any seat (blinds included).
notes: Every decision facing one raise counts, a limper's second decision included; v1 counted a seat's first decision only (+0.6% opportunities).

label: Fold vs open
description: Folded when facing exactly one raise, from any seat.
notes: Every decision facing one raise counts, a limper's second decision included; v1 counted a seat's first decision only (+0.6% opportunities).

label: 3-bet %
description: Re-raised when facing exactly one raise (a limp-reraise counts).
notes: Every decision facing one raise counts, a limper's second decision included; v1 counted a seat's first decision only (+0.6% opportunities, +0.4% 3-bets on the pool).

label: Squeeze %
description: Re-raised facing a raise and at least one cold caller.
notes: Every decision facing one raise with callers counts, a limper's second decision included; v1 counted a seat's first decision only (+1% opportunities).

label: Fold to 3-bet
description: Folded after open-raising and facing a 3-bet.
notes: v1 counted any fold by the opener once two raises existed, including a fold to a later 5-bet.

label: Call 3-bet
description: Called after open-raising and facing a 3-bet.
notes: Exactly a 3-bet in front; v1 counted the opener facing any further raise, a 4-bet included (-3% opportunities).

label: 4-bet %
description: Re-raised when facing two raises (the opener's raise over a 3-bet counts).
notes: The opener facing a 3-bet is the common 4-bet spot and counts here; v1 measured a seat's first decision only, so it saw cold 4-bets alone (hero 2.4% of 5,019 vs 5.9% of 8,745 opportunities). v2 is the standard definition.

label: Fold to 4-bet
description: Folded after 3-betting and facing a 4-bet.
notes: Exactly a 4-bet in front; v1 counted the 3-bettor facing any further raise, a 5-bet included (-1..2% opportunities).

label: Call 4-bet
description: Called after 3-betting and facing a 4-bet.
notes: Exactly a 4-bet in front; v1 counted the 3-bettor facing any further raise, a 5-bet included (-1..2% opportunities).

label: 5-bet %
description: Re-raised when facing three raises (the 3-bettor's raise over a 4-bet counts).
notes: The 3-bettor facing a 4-bet is the common 5-bet spot and counts here; v1 measured a seat's first decision only, so it saw cold 5-bets alone (hero 0% of 95 vs 10.3% of 783 opportunities). v2 is the standard definition.

label: Fold BB to steal
description: Folded the big blind facing a first-in raise from the cutoff, button or small blind.
notes: v1 did not require the raise to be first in (a late raise over limpers counted as a steal).

label: Limp, fold to raise
description: Limped, then folded when someone raised behind.
notes: v1 counted open limps only; this counts every limp (over-limps included).

label: Limp, call raise
description: Limped, then called a raise behind.
notes: v1 counted open limps only; this counts every limp (over-limps included).

label: Limp-raise
description: Limped, then re-raised a raise behind.
notes: v1 counted open limps only; this counts every limp (over-limps included).

label: WWSF
description: Won the pot, given the flop was seen.

label: WTSD
description: Reached showdown, given the flop was seen.

label: W$SD
description: Won at showdown, given showdown was reached.
